## Rule

**Crop the top-right 3×3 corner of the 9×9 input.** Verified on all 4 train + 1 test:
`output = input[rows 0:3, cols 6:9]`. NOT a whole-grid identity/transpose/flip/rotate
(prompt's "perfect-25 <=1" rumor is DISPROVEN — see Don't-do). In [1,10,30,30] one-hot
canvas terms: keep `input[:,:,0:3,6:9]` → `output[:,:,0:3,0:3]`, zero everywhere else.

## Algorithm sketch

```
# 9x9 grid -> 3x3 grid
out = grid[0:3, 6:9]
```

## Attempts

Authoritative bar: **cost 30** (manifest, sha 84b2d9b7…, owner Aditya). LIVE = a single
depthwise `ConvTranspose`, all-ones `W[10,1,3,1]` (30 elems); free attrs do the work
(`dilations=[29,1] strides=[30,1] pads=[58,6,841,-6]`).

| version | approach | visible | cost | verdict |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| LIVE | ConvTranspose depthwise kh=3 all-ones | 266/266 | **30** | floor (owner) |
| p_identity | Identity (perfect-25 family) | 0/266 | ~0 | DEAD — it's a crop |
| p_convT_kh3 | rebuild of LIVE (kh=3) | 266/266 | 30 | ties, not stageable |
| p_convT_kh2 | kh=2 (20 params) | **0/266** | 20 | 2 taps can't pick 3 rows |
| p_slice_pad | Slice→Pad two-op | 266/266 | **374** | memory 360 (3×3×10 F32 intermediate) |

## Cost analysis

cost = memory (intermediate BYTES, F32×4) + params (initializer ELEMENT count; dtype-free
per #109 "params=elements, F16 saves 0"). LIVE pays **30 = 10 channels × 3 row-taps × 1**;
memory 0 because its only tensor is the graph output. The crop = (a) horizontal shift-left-6
+ (b) vertical band-removal of rows 3-8. (a) is FREE (pad-shift; input cols 9-29 are already
zero, so the shifted-in cols 3-29 stay zero). (b) is NOT free: rows 3-8 hold real grid data
that must be deleted while keeping a 30×30 output → needs a non-monotonic strided gather.
The ConvTranspose dilated-tap trick serves each surviving output row (0,1,2) from a distinct
kernel tap ⇒ **kernel height 3 is forced** (kh=2 drops row 2 → visible 0/266). group=10
(depthwise) is forced: output must be exactly 10 channels, all colors appear. → **30 is the
forced floor.** Any 2-op crop materializes the 90-elem (360-byte) crop intermediate ≫ 30
(measured: Slice→Pad = 374). See `hard_records/convtranspose_crop_floor.md`.

## Don't-do log

- **Perfect-25 / zero-param family (Identity, Transpose, flip, rotate): DEAD.** Output is a
  3×3 crop of the top-right corner, not any whole-grid permutation. Identity = 0/266. The
  prompt's "forced floor <=1" premise does not apply to this task.
- **Two-op crop (Slice+Pad, Gather+Pad, etc.): loses.** The 3×3×10 F32 crop intermediate
  costs 360 bytes of `memory` alone (measured 374 total) — far above the 30-param single op.
- **Shrinking the ConvTranspose kernel (kh<3, dtype narrowing): loses.** kh=2 → 0/266
  (needs 3 taps for 3 rows); params count elements not bytes so F16/I8 weights save nothing.
